remarks: Tubular slide stays. One flat bell say, engraved with tulip and other flowers. Rings in slide bow and bell bow. Single eyelet in bell stay, near bell-pipe side. Slide stockings added later. Letters on garland are hatched (“schraffiert”), the date is simply engraved. On both tubes of the inner slide there is evidence of repair, approx. 80mm long, replaced with wide tube.²  Myers [e-mail 17c files] thinks this instrument might have been built in Hoch-Chorton, about a=490].
